items.text: Community health centers ensure everyone can access quality, affordable, healthcare, during & beyond the pandemic. Proud to join @providencechc for opening of their new clinic on Atwood St. in Olneyville, where they will provide a range of health & wellness services. https://t.co/GDOUoHqwAK

Had a great visit today w/ Robert, 86, in Cranston. Robert & I are both grateful for the amazing work of @MealsRI @_MealsOnWheels volunteers as they celebrate 50 years of meeting the nutritional, health, & wellness needs of homebound seniors. #MarchForMeals #MealsOnWheels https://t.co/CAEhqkTajO

Great visit to Tiverton today w/ @usdaRD officials to get a look at progress modernizing our state’s water infrastructure. Pleased to help deliver federal funding to expand wastewater treatment & reduce combined sewer discharges flowing into the Bay & local waters. https://t.co/z0OXVf3yIO

Today we honored a hometown hero, the late Matthew Turcotte, of North Smithfield, who was serving with the 2nd Infantry Brigade Combat Team of the 4th Infantry Division when he was killed nearly five years ago, in August of 2017, during a live-ammunition training exercise. https://t.co/qfAJMbM2hi

Celebrating $300,000 earmark to help renovate & equip PACE-RI’s new health clinic & adult day care center in East Providence w/ @SenWhitehouse @mayorbobdasilva. PACE builds community & connection for seniors while improving wellness & reducing need for emergency health costs. https://t.co/QpXooxHNqy

81-11: U.S. Senate just passed the PACT Act. This bill empowers @DeptVetAffairs to finally start fulfilling obligations to our veterans & ensures those who were exposed to toxic chemicals can access the timely, specialized care & treatment they need.

Not trying to flex, but check out these mussels (& oysters & clams)! RI’s seafood is a vital part of a healthy economy & diet. Thanks to @AmericanMussel @Seafood4Health @RIFoodCouncil & @NOAAFisheries' Janet Coit for tour & talk about future of sustainable shellfish & seafood. https://t.co/HrahHwNiCu

A lot of people are struggling these days w/ mental health & addiction issues. Help is available & we need to connect people in need to proper care & treatment. Today we're delivering $11.3M in fed $$$ for RI to expand access to mental health & addiction care & help save lives.

Combating breast cancer, childhood cancer, skin cancer & other cancers requires more than a special awareness month: It takes 24/7 year-round focus & commitment. I'll continue working each & every day to deliver research $$ to find a cure & improve treatment. #RIResearchBreakfast https://t.co/qZllP7OqME

With their new Physical Therapy & Wellness Center, Aldersbridge Communities will be able to care for more RIers. Congrats on the expansion & thanks for your decades of service to the community! https://t.co/rRJQjN8moT

BREAKING: Today @POTUS signed our Childhood Cancer STAR Act reauthorization into law! This is a major step toward improving outcomes & treatment options for pediatric cancer patients & continuing to make a real, positive difference for kids & families. Thanks to all who helped! https://t.co/BkUiYNi9Q0

A new stream of $15.5M in federal clean water funding is flowing to RI this week thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. This influx of federal CWSRF financing should lead to an outpouring of infrastructure investments, such as wastewater treatment plant upgrades. https://t.co/dnzqXnXwkX

How can the upcoming Farm Bill better reflect RI priorities? Here at @FarmFreshRI w/ @RIFoodCouncil listening to family farmers, local producers, conservationists & nutrition experts to ensure their ideas for improvements & reforms are included in this critical legislation. https://t.co/kZtb507vNS

New $1M federal CCBHC planning grant will increase access to mental health and substance use disorder treatment services & ensure RIers can access timely care & treatment they need. It will also help the state compete for future CCBHC funds. https://t.co/8BYdPud6Ib

Thanks to @timkaine's leadership & determination, U.S. Senate just voted to formally repeal decades-old authorizations for the use of military force (AUMF) against Iraq. Congress has the sole power to declare war and must exercise its responsibility with the utmost care.

We must cut off supply of fentanyl & invest in addiction prevention, recovery & treatment programs. Today’s move by @POTUS & @ONDCP to declare xylazine an ‘emerging threat’ is a needed step to help stop the spread of deadly tranq.
https://t.co/UG5Z5QRfHH

Congrats @EProvHighSchool & @JSDNews for earning 2023 @EDGreenRibbon School status! East Providence & Jamestown have prioritized sustainability, health & wellness education, & energy efficiency. https://t.co/c0loZ93VXl

The arts drive community connections & economic development. Supporting the arts helps create opportunities & boosts community wellness. Glad to be chatting w/ community leaders about the intersection of arts & health. https://t.co/ZVXPpTL5La

Now the fmr president can make his defense in the court room – not on the streets & not thru violence or intimidation, but w/ facts.  He deserves same fair & impartial treatment as every other person who’s been indicted for running a criminal enterprise.  No one is above the law.

The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, & Children (WIC) is turning 50! 

#WIC is vital to increase access to healthy food & boost positive health outcomes. Proud to support millions in WIC funding for RI in approps package that became law last week.

Today’s historic announcement from @EPA is a milestone is safeguarding drinking water from forever chemicals like PFAS. Billions from Bipartisan Infrastructure Law are helping states implement testing & treatment to ensure all have clean, safe water.

The dedicated doctors, nurses, social workers, & staff at @RIHospital Addiction Care Today (ACT) clinic are stepping up to help turn the tide on substance abuse, combat the devastating effects of addiction, & provide greater access to long-term treatment options.

On #OverdoseAwarenessDay, we remember those we have lost to overdoses & keep working to advance integrated solutions that make treatment more accessible & help save lives. Grateful for first responders, care providers, & community orgs on the frontline of the opioid crisis. https://t.co/iNfCxmLhGD

Rallying with @SenateDems to protect IVF treatment & lower costs for fertility care. I urge my Republican colleagues to step up & join us to actually help families struggling with infertility. https://t.co/VMHve19PlC

We need to increase awareness & research funding for women’s health issues that have been overlooked for too long. Glad to see RI researchers examining root causes of gestational diabetes & developing new solutions to improve outcomes & treatment. 
 
https://t.co/P368q4WpYN
